text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains. Try to avoid too much sugar and fast food. Second, exercise regularly. You don't need to go to the gym every day; a brisk walk or a bike ride is enough. Third, get enough sleep, about seven to eight hours each night. Don't forget your mental health: talk to friends, relax, and take breaks. Finally, keep a good work-life balance. When work and rest are in harmony, you feel happier and more energetic.
